title: Searching "not tracked" returns only untracked parts
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts -> Inventory page on the build under test, with permission to view inventory parts.
  2. Some untracked parts exist (e.g. tag "ZZAUTOTEST"); and a no-untracked-parts state.
custom_steps:
1. Type "not tracked" (and partials "not", "tracked") in the global search and read the results.
  2. Type an ordinary term (a part number or name) and confirm untracked parts are not surfaced by their tracking state.
  3. In a shop with no untracked parts, search "not tracked".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Typing "not tracked" (or a partial such as "not" or "tracked") returns only untracked parts; other search terms match on part number, name, tags and standard fields only and do not surface untracked parts by their tracking state.
  • With no untracked parts, searching "not tracked" returns an empty result set.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; "Parts Lifecycle Update" PRD (Confluence 829227015, IN REVIEW 2026-09-09), Story 6 (Search & sort by tracking state); design canvas Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026 against an IN-REVIEW spec; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R1: “Typing "not tracked" (or any partial match such as "not", "tracked") in the global search field returns only untracked parts.”
  • S6-R2: “Typing other search terms does not surface untracked parts via their tracking state, only part number, name, tags, and other standard fields drive matches.”
  • S6-N1: “If there are no untracked parts, searching "not tracked" returns an empty result set.”
